claims.text: The source defines MAGVIT: 3D-VQ video tokenizer (4x16x16=1024 tokens for 16x128x128, codebook 1024, inflated 2D-VQ init) with a BERT transformer trained by COMMIT multi-task masked modelling over 10 tasks; non-autoregressive COMMIT decoding in K=12 steps (16x128x128 in 12 steps, 0.25 s TPUv4i / 37 fps V100).
Reported numbers: UCF-101 FVD 332 to 76(L)/159(B), IS to 89.27; BAIR-FP FVD 84 to 62 (31 debiased); Kinetics-600-FP 16.2 to 9.9 (~39% cut); ~100x diffusion, 60x TATS-AR sampling efficiency.

limitations.text: VQ fidelity bounds generation; fixed 16-frame training; debiased BAIR protocol needed; naive unmasking fails (COMMIT motivation).
